name: Hello world
description: The smallest program: it prints a line.

name: Fibonacci
description: A recursive function: the Fibonacci numbers.

name: Closure
description: A function that keeps a variable of the one that made it: a counter.

name: Vec2 class
description: A class with operators: two-dimensional vectors that add and print.

name: How the lexer works
description: The first stage of the engine cut into tokens, one character at a time, by a copy of the real lexer.
controls: Space plays and pauses, S steps one line at a time (right and left arrows go forward and back), up and down change the speed, 1 to 4 pick a program, R restarts. A tap pauses.

name: How the parser works
description: The second stage of the engine assembling tokens into a tree, one line of the real parser at a time.
controls: Space plays and pauses, S steps one line at a time (right and left arrows go forward and back), E skips to the next line that matters, up and down change the speed, 1 to 5 pick a program, R restarts. A tap pauses.

name: Primitives 2D
description: A tour of the 2D primitives: lines, shapes, curves and text.

name: Perlin noise (per pixel)
description: Perlin noise drawn pixel by pixel into a small buffer, animated and scaled up to the window.

name: Image (loadData)
description: An image embedded in the program as base64, loaded without any upload.

name: Primitives 3D
description: The 3D primitives: cube, sphere, cylinder, plane, line, point, cone and torus.
controls: Drag to spin each primitive on itself.

name: 3D transforms and instancing
description: Placing objects in 3D with translate, rotate and scale, and what drawing thousands of cubes costs.
controls: Drag to turn the scene.

name: 3D models (.obj / .glb)
description: External models (.obj and .glb), framed automatically, with the three ways a file can carry its appearance.
controls: Drag or use the arrow keys to turn the model, space stops and restarts the drift, wheel or pinch zooms, double-click or Return resets. The Model menu switches model.

name: Isometric camera
description: An interactive isometric camera.
controls: Drag to orbit, wheel or pinch to zoom, double-click to recentre.

name: Voxel world (Minecraft)
description: An endless voxel world generated from Perlin noise as you move, with a view distance that adapts to the speed of the device.
controls: Arrow keys or the touch joystick to move, C switches the camera; the buttons at the top right set the view distance by hand.

name: Interface (ui)
description: The widgets the engine draws itself: menus, buttons, checkboxes, sliders and lists.
controls: Open the interface with the three bars at the top right.

name: Animations (tween)
description: Animating a field towards a target over a duration and along a curve.
controls: Click to restart the animations; the menu chooses the curve and the duration.

name: Animated sequence (tween)
description: A sequence of animation steps, each starting from what the previous one left.
controls: Click to pause and resume.

name: Synthesised sound (audio + sound)
description: A keyboard whose every sound is computed: not one audio file is loaded.
controls: Press the keys, with the mouse or with several fingers at once; drag without lifting and the note follows the key under the finger.

name: Calculator
description: A pocket calculator that runs operations in the order they are typed.
controls: Tap the keys, or type: digits, Return for =, Backspace to delete a digit, Escape to clear.

name: Game of Life
description: Conway's Game of Life on a grid that wraps around.
controls: Space pauses, R restarts; press or touch to light a cell and drag to draw, double-tap to restart.

name: Lunar eclipse
description: A lunar eclipse seen from the Earth: the Moon crossing the penumbra and the umbra of the Earth's shadow.

name: Solar eclipse
description: A solar eclipse: the Moon passing in front of the Sun, total, annular or partial.

name: Earth from space
description: The Earth seen from space, with its clouds, its atmosphere, the lights of its cities and the Sun where it really is on the date shown.
controls: Drag or use the arrow keys to turn the globe, wheel or pinch to zoom; the menu sets the time and the layers.

name: Ollin Invaders
description: Space Invaders: the fleet advances one alien per tick, so it accelerates as it empties.
controls: Left and right arrows move, space fires, P pauses. On a touch screen, drag a finger to move the cannon (it fires by itself) and tap the top band to pause.

name: Ollin Asteroids
description: Asteroids: a ship with no brake, rocks that split into faster ones, and a saucer that aims better as your score grows.
controls: Left and right arrows turn, up thrusts, space fires, P pauses. On a touch screen, the stick under the right thumb steers and thrusts, and the left half of the screen is the trigger.

name: Rally
description: A Lancia Stratos on a circuit, with a chase camera and an engine note that follows the revs.
controls: Arrow keys or the touch joystick. On a phone, hold it like a steering wheel in landscape: its tilt steers, the pedals are the bottom corners.

name: Blockudoku
description: A 9x9 grid in nine boxes: place pieces so that complete rows, columns and boxes clear.
controls: Drag a piece onto the grid. The gear at the top right opens the options, the languages and the help.

name: Sudoku
description: Sudoku with four levels, a puzzle of the day, pencil notes and hints that explain how to find a digit.
controls: Tap a cell then a digit, or type: digits, arrows, Backspace to erase, P for the pencil, H for a hint. The gear at the top right opens the options.

name: Tetris
description: Tetris as the 1989 handheld plays it, in its original look or a modern one.
controls: Left and right move a piece, down drops it faster, X or up turns it clockwise, Z counter-clockwise, Enter starts and pauses, M switches the music, V the style. On the screens before the game the arrows choose, X or Enter confirms and Z goes back. On a touch screen the pads appear with the first touch.

name: Webcam (camera)
description: Live webcam capture in greyscale, available in the browser only.

name: Persistence (data)
description: The data module: a run counter and a score that come back when the program restarts.
controls: Click to raise the score.

name: Text field (ui)
description: Typing a text into the engine's own interface, with the keyboard of the system on a phone.
controls: Open the interface with the three bars at the top right and touch the field. Return validates, Escape gives up.

name: Keyboard diagnostic
description: What a phone's keyboard really does, shown on the screen: focus, keys, and the size of the visible area.
controls: Touch the field, type, then touch the done key above the keyboard or swipe it down.

name: Weather (https)
description: The weather now and over the next days in a city, asked of Open-Meteo, with a page per city like the weather app of a phone.
controls: Drag sideways (or press left and right) to pass from one city to the next; the magnifier looks a city up.
